courses.title: Distributed Systems Fundamentals
courses.description: Distributed Systems Fundamentals takes you from the basics of distributed systems to applying it on a realistic Senior Software Engineer scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to cloud infrastructure, enough to use it alongside distributed systems day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying distributed systems to a real Senior Software Engineer scenario
Practicing distributed systems through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to cloud infrastructure
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Technical Leadership for Practitioners
courses.description: Technical Leadership for Practitioners is a focused course on technical leadership for people already working toward a Senior Software Engineer role who want to go further. You'll work through applied exercises that push past the basics and into more realistic scenarios, with less hand-holding than an introductory course. By the end, you should feel noticeably more confident applying technical leadership on your own.
learning_outcomes: Applying technical leadership to a real Senior Software Engineer scenario
Practicing technical leadership through guided exercises
Building a short technical leadership exercise from scratch
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Performance Tuning Basics
courses.description: Performance Tuning Basics is a short introduction to performance tuning for people moving toward a Senior Software Engineer role. You'll walk through the essential vocabulary and a few guided exercises that show performance tuning in context, with no prior experience assumed. The pace is gentle, with short lessons rather than a heavy project. It's a reasonable starting point if performance tuning is new to you.
